Short tours — 1 to 2 days

Day tours and overnight trips from Delhi, Agra and Jaipur. Built for layovers, business trips with a spare day, and anyone adding India to a longer route.

Tours of this length

A single day is enough for the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort if you leave Delhi early. Two days lets you add a second city without rushing either.

What the price covers

The same on every tour, whatever its length.

Included in every package

  • Private AC car, or train tickets where the tour uses one
